chunks: 5631 - And in the narration of Muʿāwiyah ibn Ḥukaym, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Ribāṭ, who raised it to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
The grandmother has one-sixth along with her son and along with her daughter.

key_terms.الْجَدَّةُ: the grandmother as an inheriting relative
key_terms.مَعَ ابْنَتِهَا: when accompanied by her daughter in the inheritance scenario
key_terms.مَعَ ابْنِهَا: when accompanied by her son in the inheritance scenario

ai.seo_question: What share of inheritance does the grandmother receive when her son or daughter is present?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance shares for the grandmother. It states that the grandmother is entitled to one-sixth of the estate in the presence of her son or her daughter, making it a concise ruling in the law of inheritance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5631 - In the narration of Muawiyah ibn Hakim from Ali ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ribaṭ, who reported it from Abu Abdullah (as), he said:
"The grandmother is entitled to one-sixth of the inheritance, whether along with her son or her daughter."
